## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the public contract it affects.

## Validation evidence

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Browser test evidence is attached when gesture, layout, CSS, or focus behavior changed.
- [ ] Browser, browser version, operating system, project, and pointer/device type are recorded below.
- [ ] Keyboard focus order and assistive-technology evidence are recorded when accessibility can change.

<!--
For gesture reports include: leading/trailing side, LTR/RTL, row dimensions,
scroll or nested gesture container, start/end coordinates, expected result, and
whether evidence is automated or a physical device. Desktop automation does not
prove mobile browser back-edge behavior.
-->

## Documentation and changelog

- [ ] Public API, CSS, browser-policy, limitation, or release documentation is updated if needed.
- [ ] The proposed user-visible changelog entry is included below, or this change needs no changelog entry.

## Review notes

List follow-up work, compatibility concerns, or a minimal reproduction. Do not
include credentials, private user data, or vulnerability details.
